items.title: hira art retreat building project
items.description: learn the methods of earth building (earth bag, rammed earth, lime plaster) and the intricate artistic flourishes yusuf adds to these ancient techniques, while helping to create an art studio and retreat space in los angeles. this will morph into a school that teaches off grid skills like solar power, composting, and general strategies for living independently in a world that wants us helpless and relying on the system that cares nothing for us. anyone who can volunteer for 5 shifts get their own day / afternoon at hira (one personal guest allowed), volunteer for 10  days and you will get to host your own intimate gathering there. free food for all volunteers who are able to give a full session of 3.5+ hours.

items.title: poetry card deck
items.description: The help of someone is needed to develop a deck of poetry cards. Someone with love of poetry + a good sense of organization. If you have good aesthetic sense for design etc bonus.
items.payment: % on every deck that is sold + credit

items.title: astralab podcast interviewees
items.description:
ideal for media / producer graduates, help find interesting guests doing beautiful things in and around los angeles for the upcoming astralab podcast, which will feature artist interviews. this is mostly a voluntary / community / informal role - i.e. you saw music you loved, there's a writer or poet you know, etc. You let us know who they are, send a link or two, if it's a go then make an introduction via email or text etc.. 

Paid portion of this opportunity is if you're able to find sponsoring advertisers for the podcast - preferably disapora and/or independent businesses.
items.payment: % of paid advertising income + on air credit as producer.
